cited_sources.text:
Legal Hold

When Legal issues a hold notice, normal deletion schedules stop for the named matter. Recipients must preserve email, chat, files, ticket records, and notes that relate to the hold. Managers must confirm that affected team members understand the hold within five business days.

Storage Rules

Internal, Confidential, and Restricted data must be stored in approved company systems. Restricted data must not be downloaded to personal devices. Confidential data should not be stored in local folders unless there is a documented business need.

Personal Devices

Personal devices may be used for limited work access only when enrolled in approved mobile device management or when access occurs through approved browser-based tools. Personal devices must use a passcode, supported operating system, and automatic lock.

Restricted data must not be downloaded to personal devices. Confidential data should be accessed only through approved company systems.

factual_sources.text:
Legal Hold

When Legal issues a hold notice, normal deletion schedules stop for the named matter. Recipients must preserve email, chat, files, ticket records, and notes that relate to the hold. Managers must confirm that affected team members understand the hold within five business days.

Retention Basics

Teams should retain records according to the retention schedule in their approved system. This public policy does not include detailed legal retention rules or HR investigation outcomes.

Storage Rules

Internal, Confidential, and Restricted data must be stored in approved company systems. Restricted data must not be downloaded to personal devices. Confidential data should not be stored in local folders unless there is a documented business need.

Data Retention

Customer contracts must be retained for seven years after expiration. Vendor agreements must be retained for six years after termination. Employee agreements must be retained according to HR retention rules and any legal hold instructions.

Draft contracts that never reach signature may be deleted after 18 months unless they are part of an active dispute, audit, or legal hold. Executed agreements must never be deleted from the contract repository.

Personal Devices

Personal devices may be used for limited work access only when enrolled in approved mobile device management or when access occurs through approved browser-based tools. Personal devices must use a passcode, supported operating system, and automatic lock.

Restricted data must not be downloaded to personal devices. Confidential data should be accessed only through approved company systems.
